    Successors of good modules #

    If every nonzero indecomposable summand of a free module is good, then irreducible successors of good modules are good (good_succ): for a non-projective successor Y, the Auslander–Reiten sequence 0 → τY → E → Y → 0 has τY a proper predecessor of the given module, and the summands of E are successors of τY.

    X = Y

    A module whose one-step predecessors are good is good, if it lies on no cycle through them.
